entries.mechanism: The 2026 pipeline reports 910.90 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 925.28, a 14.38-dollar gap. TAXSIM's 2024 Virginia run uses the smaller 2024 standard deduction, leaving 250 dollars more taxable income taxed at the 5.75 per cent top rate (250 x 0.0575 = 14.375). The residual is the 2024-to-2026 standard-deduction vintage, not a pipeline defect.

The 2026 pipeline reports 2635.90 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 2650.28, the same 14.38-dollar single-filer standard-deduction vintage (250 dollars of additional 2024 taxable income at the 5.75 per cent top rate).
The 2026 pipeline reports 7810.90 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 7825.28, the same 14.38-dollar single-filer standard-deduction vintage at the 5.75 per cent top rate.

The 2026 pipeline reports 2079.30 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 2108.05, a 28.75-dollar gap: the married standard-deduction vintage is twice the single amount (500 dollars of additional 2024 taxable income at the 5.75 per cent top rate = 28.75).
The 2026 pipeline reports 5529.30 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 5558.05, the same 28.75-dollar married standard-deduction vintage.
The 2026 pipeline reports 15879.30 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 15908.05, the same 28.75-dollar married standard-deduction vintage.
